feed.summary: Implemented Logey (26) — Heinous: after every round, Logey counts the opponent's rolled dice that showed 5 or 6 and stores that count in `B.logeyLockout[enemyTeam]`; next round's `doPreRollSetup` (after Marcus, last in chain) reduces that team's die count by the stored amount (min 1), firing `HEINOUS!` in `var(--common)` — a die-drain disruptor that specifically punishes high-die-count strategies like Redd Notorious, Marcus Glacial Pounding, and Kairan Let's Dance snowballs.
feed.next_up: Implement Fredrick (27) — check boobattles/execution.js for Fredrick's ability name and exact trigger condition, then port as the next Set 1 common following Logey.
feed.after_that: Implement Dream Cat (28) — check boobattles/execution.js for Dream Cat's ability and port as the next Set 1 common following Fredrick.
feed.roast: A turn-delayed minimum-one die-drain that only bites decks already rolling hot is Logey moonlighting as a tax auditor who shows up after you've already spent the refund.

feed.summary: Implemented Cameron (25) — Force of Nature: when Cameron wins a roll but the loser's defensive ability negates the damage (Guard Thomas Stoic, Patrick Stone Form, Kodako Swift Lose, Bogey Bogus, King Jay Reflection), Cameron instantly destroys the defender — `FORCE OF NATURE!` queued in `var(--common)` after `STONE FORM!` in the cinematic section, with `renderBattle()` onShow. Guardian Fairy absorption excluded since Cameron's damage DID land (on GF). Cameron must survive any counter-damage (checked via `!wF.ko`) before Force of Nature fires.
feed.next_up: Implement Logey (26) — Heinous: opponent's 5+ dice are unavailable next roll. Pre-roll debuff: add `B.heinousActive[enemyTeam] = true` when Logey wins or at start of round (check boobattles reference for timing), then in `doPreRollSetup` cap enemy die count at 4 when the flag is set, with `HEINOUS!` callout in `var(--common)`.
feed.after_that: Implement Fredrick (27) — check boobattles/execution.js for Fredrick's ability name and exact trigger, then port as the next Set 1 common following Logey.
feed.roast: Five hardcoded defensive abilities deep and you're calling it "Force of Nature" instead of "Force of If-Statements," but fine, at least Rosewater would respect the rule-of-five elegance over Cameron punishing the exact cards that thought they were safe.

feed.next_up: Implement Cameron (25) — check boobattles/execution.js for Cameron's ability name and exact trigger condition, then port as the next Set 1 common following Simon.
